Discover more Discover all destinations English English 日本語 Español عربي Journeys Wellness Dining Culture Celebrations & Events Active Adventure Jet Expeditions Yachts Pathways to Adventure Multi-destination journeys with Aman From Japan’s ancient cities to Indonesia’s Spice Islands, journeys with Aman span continents and cultures, weaving together multiple destinations into singular, seamless itineraries. Thoughtfully curated and expertly guided, each place is showcased through Aman’s inimitable lens, inviting guests to travel deeply, effortlessly and with privileged access to some of the world’s most extraordinary settings. Guided by Aman's Spirit Rooted in place, Aman uncovers the very soul of each destination. No matter where in the world, an immediate feeling of intimacy, serenity and belonging is found through physical spaces, ancient stories and experiences shaped by local culture. The Journeys New landscapes unfold through Aman’s multi-destination journeys. India Embrace adventure with a two-stop Rajasthan tour combining tiger spotting and lake trekking with restorative stays at Aman-i-Khás and Amanbagh. Discover more Indonesia Explore Indonesia with Aman for six nights or more, uncovering the archipelago's natural and cultural riches. Discover more Japan Embark on an enriching journey across Japan visiting all three Aman properties and enjoying unique experiences at each. Discover more Cambodia & Laos Uncover the ancient cultures and scenery of Cambodia and Laos with this seamless minimum six-night adventure. Discover more Sri Lanka Journey along Sri Lanka’s southern coast, taking in the historic Galle Fort, pristine beaches and lush tea plantations with stays at Amangalla and Amanwella. Discover more Thailand From the brand’s original home on a private Phuket peninsula to its newest urban retreat in Bangkok, Aman’s two Thai properties offer a gateway to Asia and its wealth of cultural riches. Discover more Italy Combine stays at Aman’s storied Venetian palazzo on the Grand Canal and its iconic mountain retreat in the shadows of the Dolomite Mountains. Discover more Kingdom of Bhutan Discover Bhutan's spectacular central and western valleys on a 13-night journey spanning Amankora’s five intimate lodges. Discover more China Uncover China’s rich heritage and cultural beauty with stays at all three Aman properties across the country. Discover more Americas & Caribbean Embark on a journey of remarkable contrast through the Americas, where majestic desert horizons give way to metropolises and soaring forests touch infinite coastlines. Discover more Greece & Montenegro Venture from Amanzoe’s Peloponnese shores to Aman Sveti Stefan’s fabled island with two complimentary experiences and dining included. Discover more featured journeys Two Worlds, One Journey Experience two or more worlds in one journey by combining stays at Aman’s Southeast Asia sanctuaries ( Aman Nai Lert Bangkok , Amanpuri , Amansara , Amantaka , Amanoi , Amandayan and Amankora ), unlocking exclusive benefits along the way. Discover more Journey Across the Americas Experience contrasting worlds in one journey across Aman’s destinations in North America and the Caribbean, from Manhattan’s infectious energy at Aman New York , to the peaceful Utah desert of Amangiri , the dramatic coastline of Amanera and the secluded white-sand shores of Amanyara , enhanced by exclusive benefits at each. Discover more Jet Expeditions Embark on a curated private jet tour and experience the incredible diversity of Aman’s resorts and hotels around the world, the individual geography, culture and spirituality of each of their destinations.
